plan.notes: Source: McKelvey School of Engineering, 'BS in Electrical Engineering Curriculum', 2025-2026 Catalog Year (dated 3/24/2025), official sample-curriculum PDF (ese.washu.edu/documents/BS-in-Electrical-Engineering.pdf), transcribed 2026-10-02. Course codes/titles/units and bracketed prerequisites are verbatim from the PDF (parentheses give former course numbers). A minimum of 120 units is required for the BSEE degree; semester totals 14/16/15/15/15/15/16/14. Third-year spring 'Electrical Engineering electives with engineering topics units' is a 6-unit line item in the PDF (the extraction interleaves a floating '6'); it is encoded as one 6-unit choice slot rather than an invented split. Aggregate elective line items (free electives, H&SS, breadth, topics units) are single choice slots with the PDF's exact units. Bolded courses in the PDF are typically taught fall and spring (not representable here).
